en: Bring six Golden Scale Bracers to Hank the Hammer in Stormwind.

When I was about your age, a dwarf by the name of Galvan took me under his wing and trained me in the ways of the armorsmith. Before he left for Booty Bay, he made me promise to train all those with the desire and determination to advance in the craft of blacksmithing -- so here I am -- all these years later.$B$BSo, now it's time for you to learn a little something. Make me six golden scale bracers and you will learn where smithing comes from, $N.
Bring Thermaplugg's Engineering Notes to Nogg at the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar.

You find a dirty, tattered notebook full of scribbled schematics and notes. It's quite clear even after just a cursory glance that any of these creations could be used to wreak terrible havoc should anyone ever be foolish enough to build them.
Find The Talisman of Kazdor inside of Zul'Farrak. Then, bring it to Fahrad at Ravenholdt Manor. You must complete the job alone.

From the most recent letter we intercepted, it appears the final artifact Caius desires is the Talisman of Kazdor. The letter states this talisman is somewhere inside Zul'Farrak. 

I want you to complete the job as per Caius' instructions, as not to arouse his suspicion. This means you'll have to go into Zul'Farrak alone, as usual.  

However, before you deliver the Talisman, bring it back here. We'll be giving Caius a little more than he asked for.
Speak to Fahrad when you're ready to hear his plan.

Not a moment too soon, $n
 
The manor has been keeping tabs on this "C" character you've been dealing with. 
 
C's true identity is Caius Blackwood; a powerful magic user working with the Syndicate. Our sources say he has been gathering artifacts for an unknown purpose. Only recently did we discover *you* were the one providing them.
 
Caius must be stopped, and I believe the onus of doing so falls on you. Fortunately, I've devised a plan. Come speak to me when you're ready to clear your name.
